notes.title: Midnight Yammy 8-Bit Trickster Show Coming to Steam on September 17!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to share some news!
Our brand-new 8-bit puzzle action game, [b]Midnight Yammy (8-Bit Trickster Show)[/b]—originally made for FC/FC-compatible hardware—is coming to [b]Steam on September 17, 2025[/b]![/p][p]The price will be [b]¥470 / $3.99 (10% off for the first week!)[/b].
Dive into the nostalgic 8-bit world and challenge yourself with tricky puzzles![/p]

notes.title: ✅ Midnight Yammy Closed Beta Begins! Experience the 8-Bit Action Puzzle Early
notes.notes:
[p]I am looking for testers for the [b]Steam version of [i]Midnight Yammy[/i], an 8-bit action puzzle game for NES-compatible consoles[/b]!

This is a brand-new action puzzle originally developed to run on NES-compatible hardware, now reworked to play comfortably on PC.

In this closed beta, you can experience a selection of stages from the full version ahead of release. If you meet the following conditions, we’d be happy to have you join:

✅ Windows 10 / 11 environment
✅ Willing to provide feedback via a short questionnaire after playing
✅ Recording gameplay video is welcome (optional)

If you wish, your name (or handle) will be credited at the end of the official manual. The deadline for feedback is [b]by the end of July[/b], so feel free to reach out if you’re interested!

Please contact us via DM on X (formerly Twitter) 📩[/p][p]👉 [url="https://x.com/KannoDevelop"]https://x.com/KannoDevelop[/url][/p][p][/p][p]🎮 And don’t forget to add [i]Midnight Yammy[/i] to your Steam wishlist to get notified when it’s released!
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807470/Midnight_Yammy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
